column1: # Single source of truth for the chapter layout of this course.
# Used by scripts/split-textbook.sh, scripts/scaffold.sh and the Makefile.
# Page numbers are PDF page indices into textbook/ProbTextbook.pdf, which is
# Ross, ELEVENTH edition, 769 pages. They are not the book's printed page
# numbers; the offset is 8, so printed page 1 is PDF page 9.
# THE EDITION IS THE THING TO CHECK BEFORE TRUSTING AN EXERCISE NUMBER. The
# course ran on the tenth edition until 22 September 2026 and its exercises are
# numbered differently -- that is how homework 2 came to be set on the wrong two
# problems. An exercise number copied from a tenth-edition assignment sheet is
# not the same exercise here, and the sheet in each set's assignment/ directory
# is the authority over any number written down elsewhere.
# Boundaries were read off the running headers: an odd page carries its
# chapter's title, and a chapter's opening page carries the title wrapped over
# two or three lines with no page number. Each chapter ends the page before the
# next one opens; chapter 11 ends where Solutions to Starred Exercises begins.
